mha_tomoyasu_chikazoku.label: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
mha_tomoyasu_chikazoku.instructions: A sharp, slightly nasal mid-range voice with a sneering, condescending edge, neutral American accent. Clipped, impatient and fast, requests phrased as orders, half-distracted. Dry, scoffing sarcasm; turns shrill and petulant when challenged.
